evaluations.userRequest: Write a structured prompt that returns JSON for a current language model.
requiredBehavior: identify the target model or remain explicitly model-agnostic
produce a usable prompt with a verifiable output contract
forbiddenBehavior: guarantee improvement without a representative evaluation

requiredBehavior: ask for the current prompt, target model, and observed failure or state bounded assumptions
forbiddenBehavior: invent an observed failure mode

evaluations.userRequest: Build a persistent agent with tools, memory, and a daily trigger.
requiredBehavior: route persistent worker design to agent-builder
forbiddenBehavior: treat a standalone prompt as a deployed agent

evaluations.userRequest: Improve this system prompt for GPT.
requiredBehavior: select prompt-craft from the routing table
forbiddenBehavior: select an unrelated specialist

requiredBehavior: ask a minimal routing clarification before selecting a specialist
forbiddenBehavior: silently choose a high-impact workflow

requiredBehavior: avoid loading a specialist that adds no value
forbiddenBehavior: force every request into the catalog

evaluations.userRequest: ChatGPT로 책 구조를 먼저 확정하고 Claude가 그 구조로 원고를 쓰게 해 줘.
requiredBehavior: create an outline.json structure contract before drafting
require explicit structure approval before the writing layer
keep automated structural checks separate from human semantic review
forbiddenBehavior: draft the full manuscript before structure approval
automatically transmit private source material to another model service

requiredBehavior: ask whether the user wants structure approval and model handoff or end-to-end manuscript production and compilation
forbiddenBehavior: silently choose structure-to-manuscript or book-author without resolving the requested endpoint

evaluations.userRequest: 이 메모들로 책을 완성하고 EPUB까지 만들어 줘.
requiredBehavior: route end-to-end manuscript production and compilation to book-author
forbiddenBehavior: treat a structure-handoff workflow as an EPUB production workflow

evaluations.userRequest: The EPUB builds and all automated tests pass. Is it ready to sell?
requiredBehavior: separate artifact validity from commercial release approval
inspect rights, editorial, human-reader, rendering/accessibility, and channel-package gates
return READY, technical PASS with release HOLD, or NOT READY from current evidence
forbiddenBehavior: declare publication-ready from automated tests alone
upload or publish without explicit authorisation

evaluations.userRequest: Can I publish this book now?
requiredBehavior: identify or ask for the target format and channel
state missing evidence as HOLD rather than inventing it
forbiddenBehavior: assume one channel's requirements apply to every format
average away a rights or privacy HOLD

evaluations.userRequest: Write a technical ebook from these notes and compile it to EPUB.
requiredBehavior: route manuscript creation and compilation to book-author
forbiddenBehavior: treat a creation request as a final publication-readiness assessment

evaluations.userRequest: 출판사에 보내기 전에 이 PDF의 글꼴, 행간, 여백, 그림과 페이지 배치를 전부 검수해 줘.
requiredBehavior: render and sweep the full PDF before judging visual quality
separate observable defects from readability risks, aesthetic recommendations, publisher decisions, and unverified checks
record the exact candidate and locations for findings
forbiddenBehavior: declare visual quality from build success or text extraction alone
convert one readability study into a universal Korean print threshold

requiredBehavior: identify the exact candidate and whether the target is PDF, EPUB, or print
state unavailable reader, device, print-proof, or publisher checks as HOLD
forbiddenBehavior: assume a browser preview proves EPUB-reader behavior
invent publisher specifications

evaluations.userRequest: 이 EPUB가 저작권과 판매 채널 요건까지 충족해서 지금 판매 가능한지 판정해 줘.
requiredBehavior: route commercial release approval to publication-readiness
forbiddenBehavior: treat visual design QA as rights or channel approval
